title: Implement compatible-row padding for the logical BIT caller
body:
## Summary

Implement one part of PR2753's compatible-stock handoff in `research/selected-compatible-row-padding/`.

```text
[C prefixes][R rows][body], R >= S
  -> fresh owned padding to R' = ceil(R/S)*S < 2R, separately per prefix
  -> completed row-pointwise caller on all R' rows
  -> check the added rows are zero, restrict to the original R rows
```

The new contribution is a binary-counted implementation, all-size interface proof, exact payload traffic and temporary-content bound. Earlier conditional padding arithmetic, the stock formula and the caller remain predecessor results. The callee's row-pointwise endpoint is an explicit semantic premise; zero-padding checks alone cannot establish it.

For original/padded volumes V/V', the wrapper adds exactly `4V+8V'+12` payload reads, `V+3V'` writes and `4V+8V'+16` unit moves, excluding the callee and separately charged O(V) binary control. The README also gives a conditional `<24V+F_q` logical reserve corollary from PR2753's pending reserve theorem, without independently adopting that theorem.

## Evidence

- Before, PR2753 requires divisible rows and explicitly leaves compatible-row padding to the outer wrapper. After, 8,385 exact stock plans, 702 complete patterned wrappers, forty Boolean basis columns and exact traffic checks pass. Eight runtime rejection controls and a genuine-row-swap control distinguish structural checking from the required semantic premise.
- The unchanged pinned Node/Driver and model normal forms execute all 48 GL2(F3) classes of a one-family two-MOVE fixture. Padding 49 rows to 96 preserves all 3,969 genuine Boolean columns, initializes 3,807 added columns to zero and completes 816 matched child returns across 96 MOVE residuals.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay, ten focused tests, optimized Git-free/source/typed-receipt controls, all 74 research-workflow tests, scoped Ruff and staged whitespace checks pass on Linux x86_64 under WSL2. An initial four-family run was stopped after eight minutes without a receipt; no result from that run is claimed.
- All 84 archived source exports match the exact predecessor Git blobs and SHA256 pins. The archive preserves original notices, authenticates before import and rejects preloaded source modules.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/selected-compatible-row-padding
```

Contribution commit: `80df2062cef303c05ffe89bb54b87b6b371d1253`.
[Proof, source pins, receipts and replay](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/80df2062cef303c05ffe89bb54b87b6b371d1253/research/selected-compatible-row-padding).
[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18959007).

### Scope and credit

Task `uniform-transfer-audit`, refined to this restoration boundary, priority revision 5. Started from canonical main `1696cf14e403b3eab35cd9eab27a4c2eb4e4ae38`; final refresh checked `b017900dbb94d81afec343924c1a7fa6d540a7db` with unchanged guidance, selected record, runner and consumed inputs. Fresh overlap covered 718 open PRs and 1,423 Discussion records with complete pagination. Metadata searches do not establish novelty.

David Arias supplies pending PR2753 at `7dba5452a4071a856a0b11cebdcd2d3b6bcd7659`; Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml supplies PR2697/2234 and the retained caller, packet, selected-word and coefficient lineage. Sagar Thakrar supplies the earlier conditional body-stock/padding argument. Their source notices and the component attribution are retained unchanged. Apache-2.0.

Fresh owned padding is required. Arbitrary dirty padding, high-part borrowing/exchange, physical tape placement, stronger H2, selected GL64 payload execution and full supplier admission remain outside this result. The README and TASK give concrete next steps. No selected cold replay, formal-kernel or independent human review is claimed. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way

Additive research package only; predecessor packages and frozen evidence are unchanged.

**Blast radius:** research
